title: Outta Pocket
description: Adds and modernizes the scrapped, unused, and mentioned.
body:
Adds a bunch of things that are scrapped, unused, or mentioned while also attempting modernize them.



Weapons and tools : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Mentioned_features#Rare_tools/weapons)

Flail: found in dungeons, throws a projectile that returns to the thrower and can pierce entities 

Pike: Found in buried treasure, has a large range

Diamond tip shovel: Found in desert temples, acts like a pickaxe and shovel with the efficiency of diamond and the mining level of wood

Bug stick : Found in jungle temples, used to create certain [extreme metadata variant blocks](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block#Non-standard_metadata_variants)

Prospecting pick : Found in mineshafts, makes a certain sound depending on found nearby ores

Ice axe : Found in igloos, allows you to hook to walls, while hooked mining speed is normal, press shift to decend



Blocks:

Paeonia : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Mentioned_features#Paeonia)

Red Rose : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#Java_Edition_2)

Cyan Rose : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#Bedrock_Edition_2)

Cheese : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Cheese)

Old stonecutter : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Stonecutter_(old))

Nether Reactor : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Nether_Reactor)

Gears : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Gear)

These suplement redstone by having double the range but must be converted between systems with the alternator (to redstone) and motor (from redstone) and can have their range extended with a relay

Six sided blocks : [Source](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block#Non-standard_metadata_variants)

Six sided piston

Sticky six sided piston, acts like a slime block that wont pull itself

Six sided hay bale
